gitCommit.subject: docs: 11-13 session 2 day close — BullionKing paid, PO-0074 Argor open pool, MAG open to all (#783)
gitCommit.body:
docs: 11-13 session 2 day close — BullionKing paid, PO-0074 Argor open pool, MAG open to all (#783)

* chore: 11-13 morning routine — curator fold, MAG suite settles its open sell-backs

The DEV buyback_reviewer re-filed the same scenario buyback (2c50e5dc) for the
third day: denying an automation-monitor decision does not stick while the
buyback stays 'received'. settleScenarioBuybacks() rejects/cancels the suite
customers' open sell-backs through the admin route in beforeAll + afterAll.

Also: playbook date bump (curator 11-12), CLAUDE.md archive + morning record.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Dispatch: move a Grab order back to Lalamove; tiles fit a phone in portrait and landscape

- action "unmove" on /api/admin/orders/[id]/grab (mirror of move): only while no
  Grab link, cost or live booking is saved; restores the Lalamove service the
  move now records (from_service), default MOTORCYCLE; status event; receipt
  invalidated. "Move back to Lalamove" button on the Grab tile.
- DispatchTile: every action row wraps and actions sit beside the order only
  from lg. Playwright at 375x812 / 812x375: 3 + 11 buttons off-screen -> 0.
  Guarded by dispatch-tile-layout.test.tsx.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Perf: Premium Curve paints from the server; Grab pickup window fits the delivery window

- Premium Curve app panel (/embed/our-pricing/premium-curve) is a server page:
  curve anchors + the viewer's cycle position (getViewerCurveGrams, shared with
  /api/curve/position) are in the first HTML. Browser calls 3 -> 0. Our Pricing
  web page seeds the anchors too. Chart/label fall back to the seed because
  zustand SSR renders the store's empty initial state; the store is seeded in
  effects, not during render. Chart coordinates rounded to 1/100 px (Node vs
  browser Math.log last-digit hydration mismatch).
- grabPickupWindow: pickup from window start - 30 min to window end - 45 min, so
  a Grab parcel ARRIVES inside the customer's window (was the window's first hour).
  API reference corrected: GrabExpress DOES take promoCode.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Perf: one /api/products request for all concurrent catalog callers

catalogStore.fetch shares the in-flight request. An app campaigns panel fired
/api/products 7 times on load (every card called fetch() before the first
response); now 1. Applies site-wide.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* FAQ: a MAG section from a customer's real questions

12 answers drawn from a customer's WhatsApp questions before buying MAG (fees,
premium changes, time limits, physical gold before a whole bar, grams on several
bars, whole-bar delivery, self-pickup, coin serials, held grams, paying), all
grounded in content/mag-agreement.md. The existing 'What is MAG' answer moves
into it from Selling back.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Grab: service per lane, compare Instant vs Same Day before booking, promo codes

- Admin -> Shippers -> Grab Express: default service for an order with no
  window (Instant) and with one (Same Day), vehicle (Bike/Car), and a promo
  codes table (dates, priority, on/off, last use). shipper_settings.grab_* +
  grab_promo_codes (service-role only) + orders.shipper_promo_code /
  shipper_discount_sgd (migration 20261113g, applied on DEV, RLS verified).
- Dispatch Grab tile: Check Grab cost prices Instant AND Same Day with our
  codes; the default is pre-selected, the cheaper marked; book the one picked.
  Booked by hand: which service/vehicle to choose + codes with Copy.
- Booking quotes first with the codes, uses the one that saves most, retries
  once without it if Create refuses it, records the code + saving.
- grab_promo_codes route; grab-options rules; docs + architecture counts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* chore: never commit sub-agent worktrees (.claude/worktrees/ in .gitignore)

The previous commit picked up a sub-agent's worktree as an embedded repository
(gitlink). Removed from the index; the folder is now ignored.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* feat(mag): move a holder's grams between open bars (Admin → MAG, Agreement §4A)

Admin → MAG → an open, active bar → "Move a holder": moves ALL of one
customer's allocated grams on the bar to ONE other open, active bar of the
same type and piece weight, at no cost to them (only listing_id changes;
price, cost basis and order links are kept).

- Migration 20261113_mag_transfers: append-only mag_transfers (RLS; customer
  reads own rows minus note/actor/costs) + mag_transfer_holding() (service_role
  only). Every rule re-checked under row locks (bars in id order, then the
  customer's rows): open + active both sides, same product + piece_grams, same
  stock source (consignment vs owned), no live delivery lock, customer does not
  own the fraction, no live Buy-the-rest hold, no live checkout hold or open
  sell-back/redeem, room on the destination for every gram, reason (+ note for
  "other"). Source listing cost re-priced so total MAG stock value is unchanged.
- lib/mag/transfer.ts: pure mirror of the rules + the one refusal message
  table the route maps SQL codes through; transfer-server.ts reads + RPC.
- POST/GET /api/admin/mag/transfers (409 per rule, 404, safeError), audit row,
  same-day customer email (WhatsApp TODO: no Meta template yet).
- Account (web MagHoldings + native dashboard magMoves): dated "Moved 12 g
  from bar <old> to bar <new> on <date>." line.
- MAG Agreement §4A + §4.4 reworded, last_updated 2026-11-13; FAQ item;
  known-gotchas entry (an allocation's bar is no longer fixed at purchase).

Applied to DEV only (verified: RLS on, anon RPC 42501, rolled-back E2E).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Perf: app panels drop their skeleton when the HTML paints, not after hydration

Premium Transparency (Our Pricing), the Premium Curve panel and the Home
campaign tile are server-rendered, but the iOS app kept its skeleton until the
page's React effect posted surfaceReady, i.e. after the JS bundle downloaded and
hydrated (~1 s on a phone). public/embed-early-ready.js (a static file, so no
CSP unsafe-inline) posts surfaceHeight + surfaceReady as soon as the HTML is
painted, measuring data-embed-root. Measured in a simulated WebView at 4x CPU:
ready at DOMContentLoaded instead of ~2 s later, same height (no jump). The
campaign tile uses it only when the server had campaigns. Guard test added.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* MAG transfer notice: WhatsApp template 1p1g_mag_transfer_v1 (submit + poll scripts)

Phone-only customers have no real email, so a move under §4A reached nobody.
scripts/submit-mag-transfer-template.mjs (UTILITY, run via Twilio template ops)
+ poll script. notifyMagTransfer sends it once TEMPLATE_MAG_TRANSFER holds the
approved SID (null until then = email only); the admin result reports which
channels reached the customer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* twilio: note the submitted MAG transfer template SID (still null until approved)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* feat(mag): consolidation suggestions panel + receipts keep the bar bought from

Admin → MAG → "Consolidation suggestions": a pure planner
(lib/mag/consolidation.ts) finds every customer on 2+ open bars of one type
(product + piece weight + stock source) and proposes moving their grams onto
the bar they hold most on (tie: fullest bar, then oldest), falling back to the
next bar with room, a bar they are not on (only if it ends on one bar), or a
partial plan. Holdings that cannot move (part of a gram, checkout, sell-back)
stay put, using transfer.ts's own sourceRefusal/destinationRefusal. Also lists
open bars that could be emptied whole (read-only). GET
/api/admin/mag/consolidation (bounded queries, masked phones); "Apply" runs
each move through the existing transfers route (reason consolidate).

Receipts after a move (MAG Agreement §4A): the receipt and order-history PDFs
keep naming the bar the grams were BOUGHT from (earliest mag_transfers
from_serial, per order line) and add a note per move ("Moved to bar … on …",
"6 g moved …"). The move notes are in the receipt cache key
(barSerialKeyText), so a moved receipt is a new document. known-gotchas updated.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* MAG: consolidation suggestions + receipts keep the bought-from bar; one notice per consolidation

- Admin → MAG → Consolidation suggestions (lib/mag/consolidation.ts): per customer
  and bar type, move everything onto the bar they hold most of (fewest grams
  moved), with capacity fallback, partial plans, blocked holdings explained,
  and bars that could be freed. Apply runs each move through the rule-checked
  transfer route.
- Receipts / history PDF keep the bar the grams were bought from, with a dated
  'Moved to bar … (MAG Agreement §4A)' note per move (full or partial).
- A consolidation's moves are made with notify:false and the customer is told
  ONCE (POST /api/admin/mag/transfers/notify, lib/mag/transfer-notify.ts),
  naming every bar the grams came from.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* MAG transfer WhatsApp on (1p1g_mag_transfer_v1 Meta-APPROVED); 11-13 session record

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* Spot price in the first HTML (app Premium Transparency); voice assistant knows the MAG FAQ; SDUI §246 + gotchas

- LiveSpot falls back to a server-provided spot (SpotSeedProvider) until the
  live store has one: the spot store is empty on the server, so the app's
  Premium Transparency panel, shown as soon as its HTML paints, read
  'Loading…'. Seeded by the Our Pricing page and the overview embed.
- Voice prompt: no storage/withdrawal fee, pool closing dates, whole-bar
  delivery, §4A moves (chat/WhatsApp agents already load the whole FAQ).
- SDUI §246, three known-gotchas, CLAUDE.md record.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* docs: 11-13 day close — agenda for 11-14, session record

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* governance: Razorpay register row records SG terms clauses; DPA request drafted

Razorpay publishes no Singapore DPA. The register row now cites what the SG
terms do and do not cover (2.3, 2.4, 2.9, Part B cl. 4, 1.2; nothing on
storage, sub-processors or breach notice) and tracks the request. Applied on
DEV; PROD on deploy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* MAG shop: Open pool card explains the live open bar instead of Notify me

While a public MAG bar has grams left, the Open pool type card says the bar is
open to everyone and carries no request (web, and app builds advertising the
new mag_type_info cap). Older app builds get the same explanation with a
'Notify me of the next bar' button, since they always draw one. The shop spec
route computes openPoolLive from the public listings (5 min CDN lag). SDUI §247.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzZVifcAZ6G8GrehBW

* docs: 11-13 session 2 day close — BullionKing paid, PO-0074 Argor open pool, MAG open to all
